facts.text: Billy, you're a grown man in a cape. Pick a pizza topping like one.
facts.why: Not a Freddy line. His Wikiquote lines are about flight and invisibility. It works as a note in his voice, since Freddy is the one coaching Billy through the hero stuff.
facts.fix: Billy, you're a grown man in a cape. Pick pepperoni like a hero.

fix_note.text: Billy, you're a grown man in a cape. Pick pepperoni like a hero.

facts.text: The giant piano at the toy store
facts.why: Screen Rant says that when Sivana confronts Billy in the toy store they stumble onto a giant floor keyboard, a nod to Big.
facts.fix: Billy and Freddy filming his powers on Freddy's phone

facts.text: Paid with cash zapped from an ATM.
facts.why: No ATM. Billy and Freddy pay for the beer with the 73 bucks Shazam made in donations for charging phones.
facts.fix: Paid with 73 bucks earned charging phones.

facts.text: Shazam tried real beer. Spat it straight out.
facts.why: Billy and Freddy do drink the beer, and Freddy says it tastes like vomit, but nobody spits it out.
facts.fix: Shazam tried real beer. Said it tasted like vomit.

vibe.verdict: Warm family kitchen with a good tagline, but it plays safe on food and skips what makes the film fun.
